solution.paragraph: $$\begin{array}{l} {\int_{0}^{2}\left( x + e^{x} \right)dx = \left. \frac{1}{2}x^{2} + e^{x} \right|_{0}^{2}} \\ {\phantom{\int_{0}^{2}\left( x + e^{x} \right)dx} = \left\lbrack \frac{1}{2}(2)^{2} + e^{2} \right\rbrack - \left\lbrack \frac{1}{2}(0) + e^{0} \right\rbrack} \\ {\phantom{\int_{0}^{2}\left( x + e^{x} \right)dx} = 2 + e^{2} - 1} \\ {\phantom{\int_{0}^{2}\left( x + e^{x} \right)dx} = e^{2} + 1} \end{array}$$
